name: De Librije
lunchNote: The same menus at lunch · Fri–Sat

menus.name: Librije's menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner; signature dishes can be added (caviar €75, others €50); high-end pairing €335

hotel: Librije's Hotel, in a former prison in Zwolle
bookingOpens: Online on the restaurant's reservations page, or by phone. Dinner is Wednesday to Saturday (arrive 7pm–7:45pm) and lunch Friday and Saturday (12pm–12:45pm). Closed 11–20 October 2026, 27 December 2026 to 12 January 2027 and 18–27 April 2027.
cancellation: Free up to 2 days before. After that it's €50 per person from 2 days before, and €100 per person from the day before or if you don't turn up. You can move a booking once for free.
groups: There's a chef's table and private dining.
photoAlt: The front of De Librije in the former prison building in Zwolle, lit at dusk

stay.name: Librije’s Hotel

packages.name: Kus van Thérèse arrangement
packages.includes: A night in a royal room for two sharing, the 7-course menu with champagne aperitif and five wines, breakfast and two bottles of Thérèse’s own wine to take home
packages.when: Wednesday and Thursday only; suite upgrades from +€55 for two

packages.name: Librije arrangement
packages.includes: A night in a royal room for two sharing, the 8-course menu with champagne aperitif, six selected wines, water and coffee or tea, and breakfast
packages.when: Wednesday and Thursday with dinner; Friday and Saturday with lunch or dinner; suite upgrades from +€55 for two

packages.name: Backstage arrangement
packages.includes: A night in the hotel, breakfast, and the 8-course Backstage menu with champagne aperitif and five wines at a private table where guests watch and join in the cooking
packages.when: Bookings of four to twelve guests; Wednesday and Thursday with dinner, Friday and Saturday with lunch or dinner

stay.note: Librije’s Hotel has 19 rooms and suites in a former prison next to the restaurant.
